# Hall Ellis Solicitors

> > Specialist technology, software, and intellectual property law firm based in London, providing expert legal services to businesses.

Hall Ellis Solicitors is a London-based law firm located on Fleet Street specializing in technology law, intellectual property, software licensing, and business contracts. The firm serves clients requiring expert legal guidance in tech-driven industries and IP disputes.
